_comment: Example claude_code_config.json (Claude Code user settings) wiring ethos-gate hooks.
_notes: Replace /path/to/ethos_gate with the actual install path (e.g. site-packages or a local checkout).
HARNESS_VERIFY=1 arms the verify-before-done gate; omit it in interactive sessions where you do not want the gate.
ETHOS_OWNED_ORGS is a comma-separated list of GitHub org/user slugs you own — actions against these bypass the external-action judge.
ETHOS_PROD_PATH_PATTERN is an optional regex; if set, touching matching paths arms the done-gate check on Stop.
Hook timeouts are in milliseconds. A hook that times out FAILS OPEN (exit 0 = allow) by design.
